The attached redesign brief supplies requirements, not permission for a deployment
or paid data run. Runtime/access/operations are regenerated in ARCHITECTURE.md and
OPERATIONS.md. The core design and technical specification are maintained product contracts;
backend/desktop roadmaps distinguish current implementation from target behavior.
Archived plans are historical records, not execution instructions.

## Requirement disposition

| Brief | Repository behavior and evidence |
|---|---|
| R1 | Passive cost ledger; no enforcement; legacy budget arguments ignored |
| R2, A1, A2, A3 | Authenticated loopback API; separate operator credential; bounded remote jobs |
| R3, D2 | Guard inventory in ARCHITECTURE; normal testing-phase iteration |
| R4, C1, C2 | All services non-root, no Docker socket/CLI, durable worker |
| A4, C3 | Private Neo4j supervisor with clean-stop backup; desktop uses HTTP |
| A5 | Split config, empty-is-unset, atomic model-only pins on a named volume |
| B1 | Typed temperature/token/reasoning knobs and recorded request parameters |
| B2, B3 | Catalogue validation, honest stage/date, measured flow tested with mocks |
| C4 | Dash removed from shipped topology; legacy code retained for compatibility |
| D1 | Disposable graph tests and CI with JUnit evidence; desktop full-flow suite |
| E1 | Clean-source deployment, revision endpoint/labels, immutable image IDs and records |
| E2, E3 | Generated authoritative runtime docs and mechanical drift checks |
| E4 | Known OI rows tracked; original ignored 18-finding trail absent, cannot reconstruct |
| Minor OI-06, OI-07, OI-08 | Typo, dead timeout and expansion bookkeeping already corrected |

No live measured-model run is claimed: tests never make paid inference calls.
No release/deployed SHA is claimed until an administrator invokes deployment.
The missing original E4 review trail remains an external evidence gap. Historical
OI-01/OI-03/OI-09 deployment facts are not inferred from disposable verification.
OPEN_ISSUES retains append-only history and rerunnable closure evidence.

## Verification

[Current baseline evidence](VERIFICATION.md) records the precise runs, limits and
open qualification obligations. Historical counts below are not current passes.

Canonical environment: `UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=venv uv sync --frozen --all-packages`.
The full candidate inventory is ruff, mypy, docs checks, root unit, desktop
unit/contract, integration, acceptance (separately), and desktop integration.
During development select affected tests and shared invariant checks; documentation
uses relevant lightweight checks. Use one authoritative full pre-merge candidate
run and bounded smoke for routine main pushes, per AGENTS.md. Run independent CI
lanes on separate runners and retain exact candidate evidence and a stable
fail-closed required status. Set `QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen`
on headless hosts; constrained WebEngine test hosts may need Chromium test flags.
Graph suites own disposable containers and volumes. Only a dedicated external
test database may be selected via `LIMES_TEST_NEO4J_URI`; never operator data.
The physical-backup test builds the real supervisor image, uses non-root services,
checks unauthenticated refusal, verifies a nonempty dump and graph recovery.
Worker queue tests cover replay protection, concurrent claims, output bounds,
parameter rejection and failed process exit codes. Runtime tests reject privilege,
port, source and documentation drift. Production smoke is a separate administrator
action; integration smoke uses only disposable configuration and mocked paid paths.

## News design and verification status — 2026-10-28

[NEWS_REVIEW](NEWS_REVIEW.md) records the original GDELT investigation.
BE-42 repairs its format, mixed-channel loss, row/report provenance, geography
and slot rounding defects; [VERIFICATION](VERIFICATION.md) records exact candidate
results. Tests include unchanged upstream TSV rows, explicit format/size failures,
real pipeline-to-disposable-graph/API evidence and mixed-channel retry/reextract
scenarios with mocked providers. Live article acquisition, Mentions coverage,
paid extraction quality and production readiness remain unclaimed.

[core design](LIMES_Design_Document_v2.0.0.md) is the accepted integrated target;
[ROADMAP](ROADMAP.md) defines complete packages and acceptance. Representative
agency access and an independently annotated DE/EN corpus precede claim-schema
implementation. Future verification must distinguish extraction fidelity, source
trust, corroboration, event matching and evidence lineage, including corrections,
denials, proposals and syndicated copies. Reuse shared invariant coverage and add
tests only for distinct behaviors/regressions; no fixed quotas or cumulative pass
targets. Paid corpus evaluation remains an explicit operator run. No standalone
extractor or independent event-ledger iteration is part of this roadmap.
